sourceText.he: הַשּׁוֹחֵט לַכֹּהֵן וְלַגּוֹי, פָּטוּר מִן הַמַּתָּנוֹת. וְלִיתְנֵי: כֹּהֵן וְגוֹי פְּטוּרִין מִן הַמַּתָּנוֹת? אָמַר רָבָא: זֹאת אוֹמֶרֶת, הַדִּין עִם הַטַּבָּח.

positions.claim: one who slaughters a priest's animal for the priest, or a gentile's for the gentile, is exempt from the gifts
the priest's claim to the gifts lies against the butcher who slaughters, not against the owner of the animal — so a priest who slaughters for an Israelite is himself liable
positions.basis: the mishna's wording, which frames the exemption around the slaughterer
